transcript.text: Alright everyone, before I can approve the 'Midnight Arcade' delivery package, I need to run the package-lock routine. I need signoff from rights, post-production, and publicity — each of you please report any required changes on your end so we can finalize this. The current draft has worldwide delivery, standard music credit, 4K UHD 24 fps master, English subtitles, and a June 14 publicity release. Let me know what needs adjusting.
